fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $57,600 USD (lump sum, fully earned and non-refundable). A 25% discount applies for qualifying Veterans and First Responders, reducing the fee to $43,200. The range of Initial Franchise Fees actually received during the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 was $37,200 to $54,600. For Area Development Agreements, a Development Fee of $120,200 is required (covering up to 3 locations), or $91,400 for First Responders.
raw_excerpt:
You must pay a lump sum initial franchise fee of $57,600 USD (the "Initial Franchise Fee") when you sign the Franchise Agreement.

If you (or if you are a legal entity, an individual who owns at least a 51% interest in the legal entity) are: (a) a member of the U.S. Armed Services; (b) a veteran of the U.S. Armed Services who was honorably discharged ("Veteran"); or (c) if you are currently serving as an emergency medical technician, firefighter, or police officer (each a "First Responder"), we will discount the Initial Franchise Fee for your initial Outlet by 25% (and you would pay $43,200).

The Initial Franchise Fees paid to us during the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 ranged from $37,200 to $54,600 USD.
